name: lucid
description: Lucid development entry points: API (uvicorn, reload) + web (Vite).

scripts.dev: npm run dev:db && npm run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:prepare: node tools/uv.mjs sync && node tools/uv.mjs run alembic upgrade head
